notes.en:
**Summary and General Analysis**

✦ Evanescia is a strong Elation Carry that deals most of her damage via ultimate. Her ultimate is a bounce/AoE attack that deals more damage the less enemies are present. Her main gimmick is her Energy <-> Certified Banger conversion, which she uses to fill her 240 cost ultimate.

✦ While her ultimate is bounce, Evanescia's Elation Skill is purely AoE, which makes her really flexible, being able to excell in Pure Fiction and MoC.

✦ Her gameplay loop is fairly simple. Stack as much Certified Banger as possible and use her ult, but try not to overcap. And due to Evanescia stealing other character's Certified Banger, it is adviced to play her with a mono-elation team, which is currently Yao and EMC.

**Investment Priority**

**E1 > S1 = E2 (currently)**

**Investment Explanation**

Vertical Investment Guide

Evanescia's E1 is one of the strongest of the game, offering RES PEN (which is usually at e2) and a lot more frequency to her Elation Skill, as well as making the Elation Skill give more Certified Banger points. It offers around a 40% damage increase to her.

Her signature has a standard damage increase, giving her Energy Regeneration, vulnerability a lot of crit damage. It's an okay investment, but E1 is definitely a lot better.

Evanescia's E2 increases the Certified Banger she gains from her Major Traces, greatly increasing her energy gain. Her E2 may gain value in the future as the elation roster expands.
